label: Lucius - Body Composition Import
info:
Runs daily around noon (PLAN.md §14). Watches /share/lucius_body_comp_import/ for .xlsx exports from Ward's smart scale, parses every file with node-red-contrib-officedocs (API confirmed working via body_comp_xlsx_test.json — see that flow's tab info for how the exceljs 'read'/'readRange' operations were verified), collapses to one reading per calendar day (keeping the latest), writes all 13 rich metrics to InfluxDB's body_composition measurement, pushes just that day's weight to GoDaddy's api/weight_push.php (which only ever sets daily_logs.weight if it's currently NULL — never overwrites), then moves processed files into processed/.

First run backfills automatically — nothing future-only about this design: every reading in every file present gets processed every run, so a first-ever run against a file with months of history pushes all of it, exactly as PLAN.md §14 asks for.

UNTESTED — same caveat as the other two live flows, plus one this flow adds on top: the exact row count of a real export is unknown ahead of time, and officedocs' readRange requires an explicit range string (confirmed via body_comp_xlsx_test.json, e.g. 'A1:Q41' for a 41-row sample). This flow requests a generously oversized range ('A1:Q5000') and filters out trailing empty rows itself, rather than assuming a fixed row count — not verified against a real oversized-range read, worth confirming on first real test whether officedocs errors or just returns blank cells past the actual data. Column order (A–Q, 17 columns) is taken directly from the confirmed table in PLAN.md §14, matched against the same 'A1:Q41' range already proven correct in the test flow.
